items.question: Can I try it for free?
items.answer: Explore the interactive example and manual placement for free. New accounts receive 3 one-time credits after email verification, usable separately for design generation and realistic try-ons.

items.question: What is a credit?
items.answer: A new tattoo design costs 1 credit. One realistic 1K / 2K / 4K try-on costs 1 / 2 / 3 credits. Uploading, saving, reusing designs and manual placement are free. Output depends on your operations and resolution; no fixed set or image count is promised.

items.question: How many credits does a complete workflow cost?
items.answer: Generate one new design (1 credit), place it manually for free, then create one realistic try-on: 2 credits total at 1K, 3 at 2K, or 4 at 4K. Reusing an existing design costs only the try-on charge (1, 2, or 3 credits). Each additional design generation or try-on is charged separately. For example, one new design plus two 2K try-ons costs 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 credits.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: No. Credits never expire. Buy now and use them whenever you want.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards through our secure payment partner, Waffo.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Confirmed generation failures return the credits used for that operation. Unconfirmed provider submissions require support review. For purchase refund requests, contact support@tattoovis.ink. Completed full refunds recover only that order’s remaining unused credits; partial refunds are handled manually.
